title: Product Owner
description:
**Description**
---------------

Responsiblities:

Intake and Prioritization

* Review intake requests, including change requested, business need, driving event, client impact, and technology dependency.
* Assess business value using the Business Value Rating scale and expected business impact, and recommend whether a request proceeds to discovery.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog and communicate prioritization decisions and tradeoffs to stakeholders.

Requirements and PRDs

* Create and maintain PRDs, from the initial high-level version through detailed requirements, scope, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate business needs into user stories, requirements, and business rules without prescribing a solution.
* Define goals, non-goals, success metrics, and measurement plans with the business sponsor.

Delivery and Collaboration

* Partner with design, engineering, data, and operations teams throughout discovery, build, and launch.
* Lead backlog refinement and sprint planning; answer team questions on intent and priority.
* Coordinate launch, adoption, training, and support readiness with business and technology partners.
* Track delivered outcomes against intake success metrics and report results to sponsors.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Graduate.

* 3-5 years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or a related role.
* Experience writing requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and managing a prioritized backlog.
* Ability to evaluate business cases and quantify value using estimates when exact data is unavailable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with executive stakeholders; experience in Agile teams.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* **The Application Process**
* Stage 1: Online application and recruiter review
* Stage 2: Pre-recorded video interview
* Stage 3: Live video or in person interview with hiring manager and team
* Stage 4: Offer and onboarding
* ***We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email*** ***candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com******.***

title: Brand Promoter
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for energetic, well-groomed, and confident Brand Promoters for an FMCG brand. The selected candidates will be deployed at general stores to promote the brand, engage with customers, communicate product benefits, and driveproduct awareness and sales.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a pleasing personality, and the ability to interact confidently with customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Promote FMCG brand products at assigned general stores.
* Actively engage with customers and explain product features, benefits, and offers.
* Create brand awareness and encourage customers to purchase the products.
* Maintain a professional and presentable appearance at all times.
* Build positive relationships with retailers and customers.
* Ensure proper product visibility and brand representation at the store.
* Share daily sales, customer feedback, and activity reports with the reporting manager.
* Achieve assigned daily and monthly promotional targets.
* Maintain regular attendance and punctuality at the assigned location.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Excellent verbal communication skills.
* Good personality with a confident and professional approach.
* Well-groomed and presentable appearance.
* Strong customer engagement and convincing skills.
* Prior experience in FMCG promotion, retail sales, or customer-facing roles will be preferred.
* Ability to communicate in the local language and Hindi. Basic English communication will be an added advantage.
* Candidates must be proactive, disciplined, and target-oriented.

**Salary & Payment Terms**

* **Monthly Salary:** ₹30,000
* **Applicable Working Days:** 24 days per month.
* Salary will be calculated based on actual attendance.
* In case of absence, leave, or any reduction in the applicable working days, the salary will be deducted on a per-day pro-rata basis.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: CRO Specialist
description:
We are looking for a data-driven CRO Specialist to optimize website and campaign performance by improving user experience and increasing conversion rates across digital touchpoints. The role focuses on turning traffic into customers through testing, insights, and continuous optimization.
  
  
The current position requires the following skills:

### **Responsibilities:**

* Plan, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate experiments across websites and landing pages with statistically valid outcomes.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks using funnel analysis, behavioral analytics, and AI-assisted insights.
* Improve conversion performance across landing pages, product pages, lead forms, and checkout journeys.
* Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, and event-level tracking to diagnose UX and friction issues.
* Monitor and report CRO KPIs including conversion rate, experiment lift, statistical confidence, and engagement metrics.
* Collaborate with design, development, and growth teams to implement, QA, and scale winning experiments.
* Drive continuous optimization using structured experimentation frameworks and iterative testing cycles.
* Maintain website content accuracy and consistency aligned with UX and conversion goals.
* Document experiments, learnings, and insights to build a scalable CRO knowledge base.

### **Technical Skills:**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, experimentation, growth marketing, eCommerce, or website optimization.
* 3+ years of working experience with HTML and CSS; ability to review and implement frontend changes.
* Proven experience designing experiments, defining success metrics, and interpreting statistical results.
* AI-Powered Analytics: Amplitude AI, Mixpanel Signal, Heap Illuminate
* Session Replay & DX: FullStory, Content square
* Personalization & AI Testing: Dynamic Yield, Mutiny, Adobe Target
* Data & Experiment QA: Looker Studio, BigQuery (basic exposure), SQL fundamentals
* AI-assisted UX & Copy tools exposure for experimentation and personalization
* Strong analytical and statistical thinking with a test-and-learn mindset.
* Ability to use AI-driven insights without blindly trusting automation.
* Solid understanding of UX, behavioral psychology, and conversion frameworks.
* Clear communicator with strong ownership and execution focus.
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, data-heavy environments.
* CRO Tools: Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty, Convert, Analytics & Tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4 predictive metrics, automated insights, AI-based funnel analysis tools, Shopify, Sitefinity
* Project Management: Wrike, Jira, ClickUp

### **Soft Skills:**

* Strong communication & interpersonal skills
* Willingness to learn and take initiative
* Basic understanding of sales/marketing is a plus

### **Desired Candidate Profile:**

* Interested to learn & work with latest/upcoming technologies

title: Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
About Spice Up Foods

Spice Up Foods is a growing ready-to-eat vegetarian food brand specialising in freeze-dried Indian meals. We are expanding our presence on Amazon India and are looking for an experienced professional to independently manage and scale our Amazon business.

Key Responsibilities

1. Amazon Advertising & PPC Management

- Independently manage Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and other eligible advertising formats.

- Conduct keyword research, campaign creation, bid optimisation and negative keyword management.

- Monitor and improve ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC and conversion rates.

- Allocate advertising budgets based on product performance and profitability.

- Identify opportunities to increase both paid and organic sales.

2. Amazon SEO & Listing Optimisation

- Optimise product titles, descriptions, bullet points and backend search terms.

- Coordinate product images, A+ Content and brand storefront improvements.

- Improve organic search rankings and product conversion rates.

- Conduct competitor and keyword analysis.

3. Sales Growth & Business Development

- Develop and execute monthly sales growth strategies.

- Identify hero products, new product opportunities and profitable combinations.

- Plan promotions, coupons, deals and seasonal campaigns.

- Analyse competitor pricing, positioning and market trends.

- Develop strategies to improve repeat purchases and customer retention.

4. Amazon Seller Central Management

- Independently manage Amazon Seller Central operations.

- Monitor account health, product availability and listing issues.

- Coordinate inventory planning, FBA/Prime replenishment and fulfilment with internal teams.

- Monitor returns, customer reviews and product ratings.

- Resolve Seller Central issues and support tickets.

5. Reporting & Profitability

- Prepare daily, weekly and monthly performance reports.

- Track advertising spend, sales, organic revenue, conversion rates and product-level profitability.

- Monitor Amazon fees, discounts and advertising expenses.

- Present monthly growth plans, budgets and performance reviews to management.

Candidate Requirements

- 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon India seller accounts.

- Proven experience in Amazon PPC advertising and marketplace sales growth.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO, Seller Central and advertising analytics.

- Experience with FMCG, food, grocery or D2C brands preferred.

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets and analytical skills.

- Ability to independently develop and execute growth strategies.

- Must demonstrate previous campaign performance and measurable sales growth.

Performance Expectations

- Take ownership of Amazon sales growth and advertising performance.

- Develop a 90-day growth plan after joining.

- Improve organic visibility, product conversion and advertising efficiency.

- Work towards scaling the Amazon business from 1.25 lakh to 20 lakh monthly sales over 12 months, subject to approved budgets and commercial viability.

- Maintain a strong focus on profitability rather than revenue alone.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*
